_doc: Known differences between our emit and upstream's for the emit-snapshot samples, read by scripts/diff-upstream-emit.mjs. Hand-written only. `status: intended` = equivalent or deliberate, with the reason; `status: bug` = a real divergence still to fix (kept so the gate passes, and reported as stale once the fix makes it match). Match fields: `sample` (exact or `*`), `kind`, optional `label`, and `ours` / `upstream` substrings of the normalised text.

entries.label: H.selfdefault vs H.createcomponentany
entries.reason: <svelte:self>: upstream writes an untyped `__sveltets_2_createComponentAny({…})`; we construct it through `__svn_ensure_component(__svn_self_default)`, where `__svn_self_default` is `Component<any, any, any>`. Props are `any` either way.

Relative specifiers: upstream rewrites them for the generated file's location; we leave them as written and resolve them through the overlay tsconfig's `rootDirs`, which maps the overlay directory onto the source tree.

A quoted attribute holding one expression (`attr="{x}"`) on a component: upstream passes the expression itself (Attribute.ts emits a single MustacheTag value bare), we wrap it in a template literal, so the prop is typed `string` instead of the expression's type.
entries.title: quoted single expression on a component is typed string

entries.reason: Get/set binding on a one-way element property (`bind:clientWidth={null, set}`): upstream checks it as the `"bind:clientWidth"` attribute of the element; we check `__svn_get_set_binding(null, set) satisfies HTMLElement['clientWidth']` instead, against a different type.
entries.title: get/set binding on a one-way element property

entries.reason: `slot="x"` on a component: upstream drops it only when the component's parent in the template is another component (Attribute.ts, `element.parent instanceof InlineComponent`); inside a `{#snippet}` it is passed as a prop. We drop it everywhere.
entries.title: slot= on a component inside a snippet
